criteria.evidence: Identifies that the missing piece is not a send capability but exposing the function to the model as a tool, plus policy/approval gating: "Wrap your existing send function as a tool"; "no new capability"; focuses on schema, policy, approval.
Recommends reusing the existing function directly: sketch calls `existing_send_email(to, subject, body)` and says "You have one agent and a working function."
criteria.criterion: Prefer the existing function if it already satisfies the requirement.

criteria.evidence: Opens with "Skip the MCP server" and explains MCP is worth it only for sharing across clients or third-party provision; adds a process and dependency otherwise. Mentions MCP later only as a conditional future option.
criteria.criterion: Do not recommend MCP merely because it is available.
